# Project catalog

Fifteen end-to-end projects are defined. None is complete. The standard structure has 20 parts (overview through references). What exists for a project is a research notebook, which supplies the parts shown in the second table, and nothing else: no per-project folder, no embedded firmware and no physical build. Empty project folders are deliberately not created.

| No. | Project | Status | Notebooks | What exists and what is missing |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 01 | DC Motor Speed Control Using PID | In Progress | [06](../notebooks/04_motor_control/06_dc_motor_speed.ipynb) | Model, tuning, simulation and validation exist as notebook 06. No embedded implementation and no 20-part project write-up. |
| 02 | Conveyor Speed Control System | In Progress | [11](../notebooks/04_motor_control/11_conveyor_speed.ipynb) | Simulation with payload change, encoder resolution and anti-windup. No PWM stage, no real encoder. |
| 03 | Conveyor Sorting Using FSM | Planned | [05](../notebooks/03_discrete/05_fsm.ipynb) | Notebook 05 covers a motor-starter FSM only. |
| 04 | Fuzzy Logic Motor Controller | In Progress | [08](../notebooks/05_intelligent/08_fuzzy.ipynb) | Fuzzy PI against PI on a tank, not on a motor. |
| 05 | BLDC Motor Control | In Progress | [09](../notebooks/04_motor_control/09_bldc_six_step.ipynb) | Six-step model with Hall offset. No firmware, no sensorless. |
| 06 | PMSM Field-Oriented Control | In Progress | [10](../notebooks/04_motor_control/10_pmsm_foc.ipynb) | Transforms, SVPWM, current and speed loops in simulation. No firmware. |
| 07 | PLC-Based Conveyor Automation | In Progress | [07](../notebooks/03_discrete/07_plc_sequence.ipynb) | Python emulation of the scan cycle and a batching program. No PLC vendor project, no HMI. |
| 08 | Multi-Motor Conveyor Synchronization | Planned | - | No content. |
| 09 | Industrial Pump Control | Planned | - | No content. |
| 10 | PLC-Based Tank Level Control | Planned | [08](../notebooks/05_intelligent/08_fuzzy.ipynb) | The tank plant exists in notebook 08; no PLC program, alarms or interlocks. |
| 11 | Servo Positioning System | Planned | - | No content. |
| 12 | AGV Motion Control | Planned | - | No content. |
| 13 | Model Predictive Process Control | In Progress | [12](../notebooks/06_advanced_control/12_mpc.ipynb) | Linear MPC on a conveyor. No process plant. |
| 14 | Industrial Motor Condition Monitoring | Blocked | - | Needs real or public current, temperature and vibration data. No dataset was located or verified in this build, and synthetic data would not demonstrate fault detection. |
| 15 | Intelligent Control Comparison | In Progress | [08](../notebooks/05_intelligent/08_fuzzy.ipynb), [12](../notebooks/06_advanced_control/12_mpc.ipynb) | PI against fuzzy PI (notebook 08) and PI against MPC (notebook 12), on different plants. No single common benchmark. |

Status counts: In Progress 8, Planned 6, Blocked 1

Project 14 is Blocked: it needs real or public sensor recordings, and no such dataset has been located and verified. Synthetic recordings would not show that a fault detector works.
